name: State Street Corporation

notes: Record fee revenue and record net interest income; 2Q26 revenue $4.05bn, up 17% year on year
Assets under custody and/or administration a record $57.9tn (+18%); assets under management $6.3tn (+23%)
FY2026 fee revenue growth guidance raised to 12%-13% from 7%-9%
New medium-term targets: 35% pre-tax margin and mid-20s RoTCE over the cycle; dividend raised 10% to $0.92 a quarter
latest.source: State Street 2Q26 earnings release and addendum (16 Jul 2026)

sust_note: Base sustainable RoTCE 18%: above the 16.6% FY2022-FY2025 average reported by the company, but well short of management's new mid-20s through-the-cycle target, which is untested
thesis: Fee revenue is compounding with markets and flows: AUC/A of $57.9tn (+18%) and AUM of $6.3tn (+23%) drove a raised 12%-13% FY2026 fee growth outlook.
Ten straight quarters of positive operating leverage lifted RoTCE to about 26%, versus 13%-18% in FY2022-FY2025.
The stock's debate is whether the new mid-20s RoTCE target is structural (operating model, AI-enabled servicing) or a peak-market result.
risks: Fee compression in custody and asset servicing
Lower rates reducing net interest income from client deposits
Execution risk on the technology transformation (Alpha platform, AI)
CET1 at 10.8% leaves a thinner buffer than peers
